routeGotchas: POST /v1/search does not offer machine-payment terms and returns 401; use GET /v1/search or /v1/agents/search.
Result count is controlled by count, not num_results; unrecognised parameters are ignored and can silently fall back to the default result count.
Adding livecrawl changes the quote to the US$0.005 base plus US$0.001 per requested result, so the benchmark must omit livecrawl unless all compared providers are equivalently configured.
